packageRules.description: A new major of a database image cannot simply open the data dir the old one wrote; say so in the PR
prBodyNotes: **This is a major bump of a database image.** The data dir under `~/.local/share/dev-db/` has to be migrated or replaced before the new image will start; see the volume comments in `dev-db/.config/dev-db/compose.yml`.
